title: New Yorker Caption Contest preference pairs
authors: Jack Hessel et al.; captions by New Yorker contest entrants
citation: Hessel et al. 2023. Do Androids Laugh at Electric Sheep? Humor "Understanding" Benchmarks from The New Yorker Caption Contest. ACL 2023.
hidden_reason: Excluded from DPO v6: humor-aligned but off-rubric for Mallard's 'thoughtful spoken peer' voice — it caused the v5 regression. Kept as a contrast set, not as training signal.
note: Only TEXT is held here — the winning caption, a losing caption and a written description of the cartoon. The cartoons themselves are Condé Nast copyright and are not in this corpus, so their terms do not apply to it.
